lc_person: George W. Aguilar Sr., born 1930; author of When the River Ran Wild! (2005), a memoir and history of the Mid-Columbia and Warm Springs Reservation.
item_person: George Aguilar, actor; Wikidata gives birth year 1952 and IMDb identifier nm0013520.

evidence.says: The authorized heading is Aguilar, George, 1930-. Its source note identifies George Aguilar, Sr. on the title page of When the river ran wild! (2005) and records birth year 1930. It also links Q3101365 as a close external match.
The graph key's Open Library author is George Aguilar, with birth year 1930.
The author record has one work, When the river ran wild! (OL5817444W), matching the book cited in the LC authority.
The item describes George Aguilar as an actor, gives birth year 1952, and lists IMDb nm0013520. It carries LC n2005015058 and VIAF 75719154, despite the LC record identifying the author born in 1930.

University of Washington Press identifies George W. Aguilar Sr. as author of When the River Ran Wild!: Indian Traditions on the Mid-Columbia and the Warm Springs Reservation, published June 2005, and describes it as memoir and history.

Jarold Ramsey's Oregon Historical Society encyclopedia entry identifies George W. Aguilar, Sr. as the author of When the River Ran Wild! and explicitly gives birth year 1930, independently supporting the LC year.
This separate article identifies George W. Aguilar, Sr. as a writer born in 1930 and author of When the River Ran Wild! Its Wikidata item link points to Q30141533.

notes: The birth discrepancy distinguishes two people; it is not a birth-year correction for the actor. The LC and Open Library records fit the graph key. Q30141533 is identified through the author's Wikipedia Wikidata link; direct retrieval of that item failed. LC was read through its JSON representation because the HTML page was inaccessible.
